note: GFP recreation area on Lake Vermillion, 5 mi S of I-90 exit 374 near Canistota: four campgrounds. The East Campground's pull-off sites line the lake's east shore (tight parking, narrow pads at a few); the main campgrounds sit on the north shore above the swim beach. Nine camping cabins, boat ramps, trails. --Claude
